messages:
Alisha K: opened a small PR to clarify the model card for polaris13b variants and add two quick SDK snippets + fix a broken bench CSV link. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/462
Tom B: can you summarise the concrete doc changes?
Alisha K: sure — 1) explicit table entry showing declared_max_sequence vs effective_max_sequence for fp16 and quantized builds, 2) runtime requirement note for q4_1 and nnint8, 3) two SDK snippets (embed vs generate) showing correct truncate semantics, 4) replace old bench CSV link that 404s, 5) small wording tweak to Benchmarks anchor so deep links don't break on mobile.
Ravi P: nit: users often confuse "effective_max_sequence" with per-batch limits. please include short footnote about per-batch token accounting
Alisha K: added footnote: "effective_max_sequence reflects runtime-enforced per-request ceiling; per-batch limits may be lower due to memory constraints."
Tom B: paste the SDK snippets you added?
Alisha K: snippet A (embeddings):
```python
# embeddings: prefer explicit truncate to avoid silent truncation
response = client.embeddings.generate(model=\"polaris13b\", input=[\"long doc...\"], truncate=True)
```
snippet B (generate):
```python
# text generation: stream safe example
with client.texts.stream(model=\"polaris13b\") as s:
    s.add(\"Explain the tradeoffs of quantization in production.\")
    for chunk in s.receive():
        print(chunk.text, end=\"\")
```
Ravi P: bench-bot, can you repost the updated CSV link so I can double-check the numbers?
bench-bot: Updated benchmark CSV: https://bench.redwood.ai/2026/polaris13b-summary.csv
Alisha K: docs CI (linkcheck + lint) flagged a markdown lint on the new table, fixed spacing and pushed
docs-bot: docs CI passed :white_check_mark: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/462
Tom B: LGTM; I checked mobile rendering and anchors look stable now
Ravi P: QA will smoke test snippets after lunch — quick ask: can we include a short sentence that truncate=True will drop tokens after the model context length and is not lossless
Alisha K: added sentence and link to chunking guidance. Rebased and squashed commits
docs-bot: merged PR #462 and deployed preview https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/model-catalog/polaris13b
Alisha K: leaving a follow-up to auto-generate the declared vs effective tables from bench metadata so they stay accurate: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/issues/231
Tom B: added an infra follow-up to detect dead bench links in PRs that touch benchmarks
Alisha K: closing thread thanks everyone
